Set character-mode display, choose the character writer, prepare audio and raster IRQs, clear the display, and draw the title surround before entering the options loop.
Reset the game display and sound, initialize weapon and score state, give the player four craft, and initialize stage zero before falling into the main loop.
Wait for the frame flag, rebuild the sorted sprite list, then process firing, movement, weapon selection, world updates and player death for this tick.
Advance the tick counter, reset the collision-object list, then update room actors, weapons, particles, sprite entries and input. Release the frame latch after submitting the new objects.
Wrap stage three back to stage zero. Load ship and room start, vertical room stride, facing and timer reload from the stage record. Reset cargo and stage state, construct the HUD and draw the room.
Convert the 16-bit cargo value at $2E97/$2E98 into five display digits at $5896 by subtracting successive powers of ten.

Scan the first 38 collision cells on the upper room row and record the X positions of empty cells.
Skip the current room's entrance initializer if its type is $FF. Otherwise take the dispatch jump written by the marker handler.
On alternate frames decrement the spawn timer. When it expires, choose a coordinate for the configured edge and use the craft's current axis position to gate spawning.
Find a free twelve-byte entrance actor slot, assign its spawn coordinates and path, initialize the sprite, and queue the entrance sound.

Increment the path cursor at $06/$07 with status flags preserved.
Visit the six entrance actor records to translate live positions into sprite descriptors.

Scan the room's staged exit entries and check the ship's position before triggering the departure sequence. The exit step sets the player lock at $1C and the delay at $3F49.

Draw the landing scene and animate the craft. Award the displayed cargo as bonus points and add a craft up to four when the timer has not reached its limit and the cargo total is at least 1500. Draw the failure text otherwise and wait for fire.

First writable glyph in the six-digit award embedded in the stage-success message.
Text commands for the stage failure message, including the 1500 cargo target and time limit.

Process the eight-byte vertical sprite entries at $43AF. Advance a live record until it hits a tile or room edge, submit its new position and add a collision entry. On impact retire it and start particles.

Suppress reversal through the entry coordinate. For an allowed boundary exit, wrap the coordinate to the matching edge of the new room, adjust the layout ID by one or the stage's vertical stride, then continue directly into room setup.
